name: Steganography
description: The adversary applies steganography to conceal information within another message or physical object.

subtechniques.name: Embed files into videos
subtechniques.description: Files may be hidden inside video’s (video steganography).

subtechniques.name: Steganography combined with encryption
subtechniques.description: Steganography combined with encryption make it harder to gain unauthorized access to information.

procedures.name: DeepSound
procedures.description: DeepSound is a steganography tool and audio converter that hides secret data into audio files. The application also enables you to extract secret files directly from audio files or audio CD tracks.https://github.com/Jpinsoft/DeepSound

procedures.name: Infinite storage glitch
procedures.description: AKA ISG lets you embed files into vide and upload them to YouTube as storage. https://github.com/DvorakDwarf/Infinite-Storage-Glitch

procedures.name: Steganography Online
procedures.description: Steganography Online is an online tool to encode messages into images. https://stylesuxx.github.io/steganography/
